## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Portuguese-language turn-based idle RPG inspired by DC Worlds Collide, featuring 320 DC characters in a 2D presentation with responsive phone/tablet support.

## Requirements
- Deliver the playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Include 320 DC characters, turn-based idle RPG gameplay, 2D presentation, and phone/tablet support.

## Decisions
- Built a standalone browser game using HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript; character art is generated with CSS rather than external assets.
- Named the game “Crise Infinita”; included campaign combat, squad management, idle rewards, missions, recruiting, and local saves.

### Completed
- Added responsive game interface and gameplay in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.
